episodes.title: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Suburban mum Mia suspects her husband of cheating and enlists old friend Oscar, a private investigator. But when Jerry turns up dead, her life is turned upside down.

episodes.title: New Phone, Who Dis?
episodes.summary: Reeling from Jerry's death, Mia must plan a funeral while a ruthless gangster hunts her down, demanding Jerry deliver what he owed him.

episodes.title: The Talented Mr. Roberts
episodes.summary: Mia invites herself to a PTA dinner party and enlists Oscar to steal a passport from the host's safe to satisfy a dangerous cartel demand.

episodes.title: Blonde Woman Vision Board
episodes.summary: After a key cartel contact turns up dead, Mia goes undercover to help gangster DMac save his operation and keep them both alive.

episodes.title: Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner
episodes.summary: Mia orchestrates a port heist to move a cocaine shipment. When the truck driver is incapacitated, Oscar steps in, but worlds collide with explosive results.

episodes.title: Till Death Do Us Part Two
episodes.summary: Mia is pulled into an all-out gang war over 200 kgs of cocaine. Old secrets surface, loyalties shatter and Mia emerges as an unlikely new cartel player.
